news.title: French FA accuses Infantino of ‘seriously damaging’ football as it withdraws support
news.lede: ‘Image and unity’ of game affected, FFF president says. It will consult sacked former Fifa official Kevin Lamour. The French Football Federation’s president, Philippe Diallo, said Gianni Infantino had “seriously damaged the image and the unity of football” as he announced the end of France’s support for the Fifa president’s re-election. The FFF’s executive committee unanimously voted on Thursday to withdraw its backing, which had been formalised at the end of June.

news.title: Lekjaa: Morocco to host 2030 World Cup final
news.lede: RABAT: Moroccan Football Federation president Fouzi Lekjaa has claimed that Morocco will host the 2030 FIFA World Cup final at the planned Hassan II Stadium in Ben Slimane, near Casablanca. FIFA has yet to officially decide which stadium will stage the final, with Morocco and Spain competing to host the tournament’s showpiece match. According to Spanish news agency EFE, Lekjaa made the claim during a political event in Bouznika, saying that Ben Slimane Province would have the honor of hosting the 2030 World Cup final. Located about 60 kilometers from Casablanca, Ben Slimane is home to the Hassan II Stadium, which is currently under construction.

news.title: Chelsea icon & Infantino ally Eto'o accused of bagging nearly £500k from Russia
news.lede: FORMER Chelsea striker Samuel Eto’o has been accused of snaffling nearly £500,000 of Russian cash – as the war for Fifa’s future rumbles on. Cameroon legend Eto’o, 45, has emerged as one of embattled Gianni Infantino’s biggest backers in the Swiss bureaucrat’s fight to hold onto the leadership of the global game. But the ex-Barcelona and Inter Milan forward is facing another fight – with the Fifa leadership being accused of intervening in the demand for a probe into the missing money. Eto’o’s accusers, ousted members of the Cameroon FA Fecafoot which he has run since 2021, claim the cash was paid into his personal account at a Qatar-based bank after a friendly between the Indomitable Lions and Russia in October 2023.

news.title: Morocco names Casablanca as 2030 World Cup final venue
news.lede: The FIFA World Cup Trophy is displayed during the Los Angeles stop of The FIFA World Cup 26 Trophy Tour by Coca-Cola at LA Live in Los Angeles on March 24, 2026. Morocco has announced Casablanca as the venue for the 2030 FIFA World Cup final, despite the governing body, FIFA, yet to officially confirm where the tournament’s showpiece match will be played. According to Reuters, the President of the Royal Moroccan Football Federation, Fouzi Lekjaa, disclosed the plan on Thursday at a political party event in Bouznika, Morocco. Lekjaa was quoted by Spanish news agency EFE as saying the Benslimane province, near Casablanca, would host the final.

news.title: Casablanca will host 2030 World Cup final, says Moroccan federation chief
news.lede: RABAT: The 2030 World Cup ‌final will be held in Casablanca, the President of the Royal Moroccan Football Federation was reported as saying by Spanish news agency EFE on Thursday. Soccer’s world governing body FIFA has yet to announce the venue of the final, with Spain and Morocco in a heated battle to host soccer’s biggest showpiece match. “The province of Benslimane will have ‌the honour of ‌hosting the 2030 World Cup ‌final,” Fouzi Lekjaa told a political party event in Bouznika, Morocco on Thursday, EFE reported. Benslimane is a city 60km from Casablanca and the site of the $12-billion Hassan II stadium, which is being built for the World Cup with a projected capacity of 115,000.
